summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Brazil Lacrosse athlete monitoring system. Backend APIs working at 92.9% success rate (26/28 tests passed). Frontend largely functional with staff dashboard, athlete login, Morning Check-In form, and menstrual cycle tracking working. Found critical issues with athlete detail page loading and 2 backend API endpoints returning 520 errors.

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix 2 critical backend API issues: 1) Morning Check-In API (/api/readiness) returning 520 error - this blocks athlete check-in submissions. 2) ACWR Gabbett API (/api/staff/athlete/{id}/acwr-gabbett) returning 520 error - this prevents ACWR cards from displaying. Also investigate athlete detail page loading issue. Admin credentials (admin@brazillacrosse.com / demo123) don't work - only coach credentials work.
